title: Fried Eggs with Sausage, Avocado and Tomato
blurb: A simple breakfast plate of fried eggs and sausages with fresh avocado and tomato on the side.
steps: Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and add the sausages.
Cook the sausages for 6 to 7 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
While the sausages cook, halve the avocado, remove the stone and scoop the flesh onto a plate.
Cut the tomato into quarters and arrange on the plate with the avocado.
When the sausages are done, transfer them to the plate and return the pan to the heat.
Add the remaining oil to the pan and crack in the eggs.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks remain runny.
Slide the eggs onto the plate alongside the sausages and serve.
